children: , a global leader in technology-enabled industrial asset integrity and laboratory testing solutions, today announced the opening of several new locations, expanding its field services footprint to bring MISTRAS teams and capabilities closer to customers in key industrial markets across the United States.
MISTRAS has expanded its field services presence with new locations in:

The expansion strengthens MISTRAS’ presence in established markets while extending its reach into regions with demand across energy, power generation, aerospace and defense, advanced manufacturing, data centers, and other critical industries.

The new field locations are strategically positioned closer to customer operations, providing local access to MISTRAS’ broader platform of advanced inspection technologies, condition monitoring, engineering, and integrity management solutions. This increased proximity enables MISTRAS to improve responsiveness, reduce mobilization time and costs, and better support customers with the expertise and capabilities they need.

“Our customers operate critical assets across the country, and being closer to them matters,” said Natalia Shuman, President and Chief Executive Officer of MISTRAS Group. “Expanding our field presence allows us to respond more efficiently, strengthen our customer relationships, and bring more of MISTRAS’ capabilities directly to their operations. It is an important part of how we continue to grow alongside our customers and serve their evolving needs.”

The new locations are part of MISTRAS’ broader strategy to strengthen its field services network and position its people and capabilities closer to the customers and assets it serves. Through its integrated platform of technology-enabled solutions, MISTRAS helps customers maximize asset integrity, uptime, and safety while staying a step ahead of risk, failure, and uncertainty.
